responsibility: Declares the public entry points for call-specific constant folding in GCC’s tree folder. It provides the overloads of fold_const_call for one-, two-, and three-argument combined_fn invocations and the helper that canonicalizes comparison results into target integer tree constants, separating generic expression folding from builtin/internal-call evaluation logic in fold-const-call.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the narrow call-folding entry points and comparison-result helper for the call-specific folder implemented in gcc/fold-const-call.cc; unlike that .cc file, it contains only the interface, and unlike the broader fold-const files it is limited to function-call folding.
